name: Browser Use
shortDescription: Open-source Python agent that controls a browser. Install it yourself.
longDescription: Browser Use is a Python agent for driving a browser. It can open pages, click, and type. Their hosted cloud browsers are billed separately, and you still bring your own browser and model.
pricingNotes: Cloud stealth browsers billed separately per docs/marketing.
freeTierNotes: Pay as you go after a free start. No monthly subscription.
bestFor: Agents that need to open pages, click, and type
Python projects that can bring their own browser and model
notIdealFor: Jobs that only need a web search API
A no-code hosted agent with no local setup
strength: Browser Use 0.13.11 is built for agents that open pages, click, and type.
weakness: You bring your own browser and model, and their hosted cloud browsers are billed separately.

handsOn.detail: We installed version 0.13.11 and confirmed it loads. We did not sign up, pay, or run it on a real task.
